# GeneFox developer documentation

> GeneFox is a genomics analysis runtime with a command-line tool, an MCP server, and R and Python clients.

## Command line and MCP

- [CLI and MCP server](https://genefox.app/docs/)
- [Tool catalogue](https://genefox.app/docs/tools/)

- [Python index for language models](https://genefox.app/python/llms.txt)
- [Python full text](https://genefox.app/python/llms-full.txt)
